<?php
class QuietArrowCVPayload {
    public function __destruct() { global $watch, $readerWeak, $selector; echo "PAYLOAD;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "CLOSURE_GONE;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;"; echo $readerWeak->get() !== null ? "RECEIVER_LIVE;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;"; $selector = "after-payload"; }
}
class QuietArrowCVEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$payload = new QuietArrowCVPayload;
$held = fn() => $payload;
$payload = null;
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietArrowCVEmptyGet;
$readerWeak = WeakReference::create($reader);
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "after-payload" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo $readerWeak->get() === null ? "RECEIVER_GONE;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
$readerWeak = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietArrowLiteralPayload {
    public function __destruct() { global $watch, $readerWeak, $selector; echo "PAYLOAD;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "CLOSURE_GONE;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;"; echo $readerWeak->get() !== null ? "RECEIVER_LIVE;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;"; $selector = "after-payload"; throw new Exception("capture"); }
}
class QuietArrowLiteralEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$payload = new QuietArrowLiteralPayload;
$held = fn() => $payload;
$payload = null;
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietArrowLiteralEmptyGet;
$readerWeak = WeakReference::create($reader);
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->value); echo "BAD_DELIVERY;"; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo "CAUGHT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_DESTINATION;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "after-payload" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo $readerWeak->get() === null ? "RECEIVER_GONE;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
$readerWeak = null;
echo "DONE;";
